name: Lithuania
description: Lithuania from the last pagan state of Europe and the Grand Duchy to the Commonwealth, Russian rule, independence, Soviet occupation and 1990.

checkpoints.name: The Grand Duchy
checkpoints.note: Lithuania was the last pagan state in Europe. Its grand dukes ruled a huge land and beat the Teutonic Knights at Grunwald in 1410.

checkpoints.name: The Commonwealth
checkpoints.note: Lithuania and Poland formed one commonwealth until the partitions of the 1790s.

checkpoints.name: Russia and the republic
checkpoints.note: Russia ruled until 1915. Lithuania declared independence in 1918.

checkpoints.name: Occupation and freedom
checkpoints.note: Soviet occupation began in 1940. Lithuania declared independence again in 1990 and joined the EU and NATO in 2004.
